- Declared: `ParsedScholarCommand.continue?: true` command-syntax.ts:9-10.
- Set: command-syntax.ts:29-34 (action === "learn" and trailing /(?:^|\s)continue/i, with quote-balance check) and returned command-syntax.ts:50.

- Exam submission confirmation (the load-bearing one): `ctx.ui.confirm(\`Submit ${exam.title}?\`, ...)` with body `N questions · A answered · B blank`, blank list, `Submitting is final. data.summary: Recon of command/resume behavior in the pi-scholar extension (entry index.ts; all anchors relative to C:/Users/basam/.pi/agent/extensions/scholar). Bare `/scholar exam` (no scope) reads book.exams (persisted as one visible Markdown note per exam under Scholar/Books/<book>/Exams/), filters status !== "graded", and if any remain builds a ctx.ui.select picker titled `Resume an unfinished exam from <book>` with per-exam labels plus "Start a new exam instead…"; if none remain it falls through to resolveExamScope, an interactive ctx.ui.input text prompt (up to 3 tries). Learn reopen is fully deterministic (resolveLearnSection, no picker). Three state-load sites in commands.ts swallow errors via `.catch(() => undefined)`; the help one misreports a real load failure as "No book currently selected". `parsed.continue` is parsed but has zero consumers repo-wide — dead branch.

data.architecture: Layered: index.ts registers the `scholar` command -> commands.ts parse+dispatch -> storage.ts (loadBookState -> note-storage.ts readNoteBook/readBookAuthority) reads the whole book from visible Obsidian Markdown. Exams are individual notes under `<vault>/Scholar/Books/<bookDir>/Exams/`. Mode handlers (learn/exam/tutor) run in commands.ts and delegate to runtime-coordinator + tool-controller. Exam persistence is note-only; the only pointer in the book note is currentExamId. No hidden DB.

- Picker construction commands.ts:236-253 `chooseUnfinishedExam`:
  • Data: `unfinishedExams(book)` = book.exams filtered `status !== "graded"`, sorted `right.createdAt.localeCompare(left.createdAt)` (commands.ts:204-207).
  • No select API → deterministic fallback `current || unfinished[0]`, no prompt (commands.ts:243-245).
  • Labels: active exams via `examPaperLabel` (commands.ts:255-264) `<title> [<id>] — <answered>/<total> answered` | `— answer markers need repair` | `— answer paper missing or needs repair`; otherwise `examResumeLabel` (commands.ts:210-217) `<title> — <n> question(s) · not yet submitted` / `submitted · awaiting grading` / `draft · questions not built yet`.

- No picker. `resolveLearnSection(book, parsed.value)` (domain.ts:466-485): bare value → `findSection(book, book.currentSectionId)` only if status learning/review or it has an unanswered question (domain.ts:468-471); explicit value → chapter/section selector; a fully complete chapter throws `Chapter N is complete. - command-syntax.ts:105 (exam completions) and :144 (learn/tutor completions): silent → empty items / `return null`.
- command-syntax.ts:81: `listBookStates(...).catch(() => [])` (open completions, silent).
- index.ts:237: settledBook load swallowed; undefined → the "setup paused with outline status …" notice (index.ts:238-242) is skipped.

- Set: command-syntax.ts:29-34 (action === "learn" + trailing /(?:^|\s)continue/i with quote-balance check), returned command-syntax.ts:50.

Blank answers receive 0 points.`, `Save your Obsidian edits first. Later edits will not change this submission.` — tool-controller.ts:502-510. Gated on `ctx.hasUI` + `ui.confirm` (tool-controller.ts:494-495); bare `exam submit` additionally requires `ui.select` + `ui.confirm` (commands.ts:525-526).
- Stale-content re-confirmation (must be preserved): exam changed while confirming → throw `The exam changed while submission was being confirmed. Nothing was submitted; run submit again to confirm the updated answers.` (tool-controller.ts:523-526).

- Hash-binding: `examFormFingerprint` tool-controller.ts:505,519; formHash in examQuestion details note-records.ts:180,196.

- tests/verify-scholar-exam-experience.mjs:191-230 — graded filtered (196-197), single exam still shown + `Start a new exam instead…` (204-209), decline/fallback, currentExamId preference (211-230).
- tests/verify-scholar-exam-scope-prompt.mjs:78-131 — accepted scope (80-84), re-ask after unmatched (90-95), bad command-line scope reopens picker (100-105), bounded 3 tries + "no exam was created" (110-115), cancel creates nothing (118-121), no-UI explains instead of looping (126-130).

- tests/verify-scholar-input-lock.mjs:886-889 — pins load-failure UX `/no selected book.*open one explicitly/i` (the commands.ts:472-473 text reached via swallowed commands.ts:460 load) and asserts no book authority created.
- Learn deterministic resume: tests/verify-scholar-routing.mjs:63-125 (resolveLearnSection explicit/ambiguous/complete-chapter throw), tests/verify-scholar-question-resume.mjs:193-196 (bare Learn and chapter reopening resume unfinished practice).
- No test exercises `parsed.continue`; no test drives bare `exam` through handleScholarCommand's picker path (only chooseUnfinishedExam directly).
